name: it-inps-contributions
description: Italian INPS social contributions for the self-employed, tax year 2026, centred on the gestione separata for professionals with a VAT number and no professional fund. Covers who is in it, the 2026 rates (26.07% with no other cover, 24% for pensioners and the otherwise insured, 33.72% and 35.03% for collaborators), the EUR 122,295 massimale, the EUR 18,808 minimale and months credited, the 4% rivalsa, Quadro RR, the 80% acconto rule, F24 causali and deadlines, sanzioni civili and the 2026 definizione agevolata. Gives the 2026 headline figures for artigiani and commercianti (fixed contributions on the minimale, 24% and 24.48%, the 35% cut for forfettari) and points to it-inps-artigiani-commercianti for the detail. Trigger on: gestione separata, INPS freelance, aliquota INPS 2026, rivalsa 4%, Quadro RR, acconto INPS, massimale INPS, contributi artigiani commercianti. Out of scope: employees (italy-payroll, it-employer-contributions), professional funds (it-inps-artigiani-commercianti), in
